# IBM X-Force Exchange

IBM X-Force Exchange is a threat intelligence sharing platform for researching security threats, aggregating intelligence, and collaborating on cybersecurity insights

Category: Security & Ops. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/ibm-x-force-exchange/.

## Actions

- **Generate API Key and Password**: Generate a new API key and password pair for IBM X-Force Exchange authentication.
- **Get Latest Public Collections** (read-only): Retrieve latest public Collections from IBM X-Force Exchange.
- **Get Public Collections Paginated** (read-only): Retrieve all public Collections using pagination from IBM X-Force Exchange.
- **Get User Profile Information** (read-only): Retrieve authenticated user's profile information from IBM X-Force Exchange.
- **Get Current API Version** (read-only): Retrieve current running API version information from IBM X-Force Exchange.
- **Get IPR Category List** (read-only): Retrieve the complete list of IP reputation categories from IBM X-Force Exchange.
- **Get URL Category List** (read-only): Retrieve the complete list of URL categories from IBM X-Force Exchange.
